name: player_los_from_fx_offset
description: AINet::HasLineOfSightFromLocalPlayerFxOffset hides the tested node and local player root, raycasts between the local player's fx offset and a target point, restores raycastability, and reports whether the path is blocked.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this player helper should be revisited with the surrounding player/camera/raycast source cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x401d50 validates the fastcall node/point ABI with one stack direction argument, local-player state access through g_GameStateOrMapTable, variant-tag copy, temporary raycastable disable/restore for the supplied node and player root, DI break/stop setup, direction-dependent ray endpoints using fxOffsetWorld, RaycastFindClosest, and return of zero only when the raycast succeeds with at least one candidate.

The native smoke constructs local player/game state and an empty DI world, verifies both direction modes through the raycast endpoint globals, checks variant-tag propagation, break/stop cleanup, raycastability restoration, and the no-candidate return path.
